# AGENTS.md — 11-online-course

Instructions for AI coding agents working in this folder.

## Context
- Template: **SQL in 30 Evenings**, online course, style "Squared exercise book, red pen".
- Stack: Vue 3, Vite. Do not add dependencies unless the user asks.
- The design contract is in `DESIGN.md`. Read it before changing anything visual.

## Files
- `src/content.js` — syllabus, quiz questions and answers, all copy (EN + RU)
- `src/App.vue` — whole page: cover, contents, graded quiz
- `src/style.css` — tokens at the top, grid paper and pen marks

## How to run
- `npm install`
- `npm run dev`
- `npm run build   # ./dist`

## Rules
- Content changes go to the content file, not into markup or components.
- Every user-facing string exists in **en** and **ru**. English is the default; `?lang=ru` and the language button switch it.
- Colors, fonts, radii and spacing are tokens. Change tokens, not individual elements.
- Keep the signature block: A quiz graded by the teacher's red pen: ticks, crosses, ringed right answers and a circled school mark.
- Keep accessibility: semantic headings, visible focus, alt text, `prefers-reduced-motion` support, body text contrast ≥ 4.5:1.
- Keep it static: no backend, no booking or payment flows.
- Text sits on the grid: line-heights are multiples of the 20px cell.
- Red is only the teacher's pen and the margin. Students write in blue.
- Kurale for print, Marck Script only for handwriting, PT Mono for code and page numbers.
- Pen marks are SVG paths drawn once with stroke-dashoffset.
- The name on the cover is stored only in this browser.

## Done means
- The page builds/opens without console errors.
- Both languages render with no missing strings.
- Layout works from 360 px to 1920 px wide.
